newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BROWN BROS UPS BROKER ESTIMATES.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BROWN BROS UPS BROKER ESTIMATES.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman said analyst Raphael Soifer raised earnings per share estimates on Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc and Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co.
-- said estimates "had originally assumed markets that were somewhat less favorable than what we've seen so far in actuality."
-- for Morgan Stanley, raised third quarter view to $1.00 a share from $0.80 and fiscal 1997 to $3.55 from $3.35.
-- for Lehman, raised third quarter to $1.20 from $1.05 and the year to $4.30 from $4.00.
